data.name: Maakool
data.gender_notes: Maakool is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who possesses extensive knowledge and understanding, a sage or scholar. The name Maakool carries the meaning “The Wise One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Maakool usually hope their child will grow to embody the wise one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek wisdom and knowledge from the divine source
data.etymology: Maakool belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Wise One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maakool total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: ماكول
in_arabic.long_meaning: ماكول هو اسم عربي يعود إلى الجذر م أ ك ل، يعني المرجو أو المأمول، والذي يجد Basisه في القرآن الكريم، حيث يُشير إلى الأشياء المرغوبة أو المطلوبة، وله أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية بسبب دلالته على الأماني والأحلام

in_urdu.name: ماکول
in_urdu.long_meaning: ماکول ایک عربي نام ہے جو م أ ک ل کے gốc سے اخذ ہوا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مرجو یا ماہول، جو قرآن پاک میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور جو اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہم ہے کیونکہ اس سے امیدیں اور خواہشیں ظاہر ہوتی ہیں

in_hindi.name: माकूल
in_hindi.long_meaning: माकूल एक अरबी नाम है जो म अ क ल के मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है इच्छित या अभिलाषित, जो कुरान में उल्लेखित है, और जो भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह आशाओं और आकांक्षाओं को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: ماکول
in_pashto.long_meaning: ماکول د عربي نوم دی چې د م أ ک ل څخه اخیستل شوی، چې معنا یې ده غوښتل شوی یا هيله شوی، چې قرآن کريم کې ياد شوی دی، او چې په افغان/پښتنو دود کې ډير مهم دی ځکه چې دا له هيلو او ارمانونو څخه ډک دی

in_english.name: Maakool
in_english.long_meaning: Maakool is an Arabic name derived from the root m a k l, meaning the desired or hoped for, which is referenced in the Quran, and holds significant importance in Islamic culture due to its representation of aspirations and dreams, symbolizing positivity and optimism

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د ماکول تلفظ ما کول دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Maakool holds significant cultural value in the Islamic community, as it signifies someone who has attained a high level of knowledge and understanding. This name is often given to individuals who are deeply rooted in their faith and have dedicated their lives to the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. In Arabic culture, education and knowledge are highly valued and admired, and those who possess these qualities are held in high esteem.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Maakool also carries deep spiritual significance for Muslims, as it represents a person who has delved deep into the mysteries of their faith and has gained a rare understanding of the divine. This name can be seen as a reminder to aspire towards greater spiritual growth and knowledge, and to strive to be a beacon of wisdom and understanding for others. In Islamic tradition, seeking knowledge is a means of drawing closer to Allah, and the name Maakool can be viewed as a reflection of this spiritual pursuit.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Wise One" symbolizes One who possesses extensive knowledge and understanding, a sage or scholar. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Maakool serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the wise one.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Maakool is mentioned in the book 'The History of the Arabs' by al-Tabari. The name Maakool carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Maakool was used to describe a tribe in the Arabian Peninsula.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Maakool remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
